About

What this is

LoL Classic Builds is a fan project dedicated to the League of Legends Classic mode (the return to Season 3). We collect off-meta builds for the mode's 60 champions — AP Yi, AP GP, one-shots, ADC picks and much more — each with a how-to-play guide, items, runes, masteries and skill order. Plus a roulette that rolls you a champion, lane and build for your next game.

Why we made it

We're the LoL Classic Builds team: players shaped by the old school who wanted a simple, fun place to experiment with the trolliest picks of Season 3, without the seriousness of the meta. The idea is that you drop in, spin the wheel and have a laugh trying something different.

Contribute

Got a build we should add, or spotted something to fix? We love suggestions. Email us at contact@lolclassicroulette.com.
